description: This file defines a React component 'RequireAuth' that manages route access control based on user authentication, permissions, feature flags, and deployment environment. It includes a helper function 'checkFeatureFlag' to verify feature flags and handles various deployment scenarios such as open source, cloud, and enterprise.

methods.name: checkFeatureFlag
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature flag is enabled based on the features object; redirects to '/unauthorized' if not enabled.
